input: /chrome-devrel Review [feature] for launch readiness. Fully analyze Mozilla and WebKit standards positions, the TAG review, incubation, and all substantive cross-links. Treat no signal as no recorded position, not neutral.
intent: A launch-readiness review must reconstruct the full primary-source standards and incubation evidence graph rather than copy dashboard labels or summarize only issue opening comments.
requiredBehaviors: treat no signal, no position, open request, no response, and silence as absence of an attributable final recorded position rather than neutral, support, opposition, or low risk
separate formal browser-project positions from attributable individual comments and model inference
read complete Mozilla and WebKit position threads including labels, state, chronology, replies, and linked implementation or standards evidence
read the complete TAG review and distinguish reviewer questions, author responses, landed changes, reviewer confirmation, and actual closure resolution
inventory current incubation explainers, specifications, IDL, questionnaires, examples, issues, pull requests, discussions, releases, and design-significant commits

search and reconcile Chromium Issues Gerrit source and tests, WebKit Bugzilla source and tests, Mozilla Bugzilla source and tests, and shared WPT status history using feature aliases IDL members flags spec URLs bug IDs and test names
freeze a retrieval cutoff and canonical seed universe including current and migrated repositories before traversal
retrieve and reconcile paginated open and closed repository totals, screening every closed item into design-significant, screened-out, or blocked
extract substantive links deterministically from authored content, canonicalize node identities, deduplicate cycles with visited node and edge sets, and preserve source comment provenance
follow every substantive cross-link that supports or challenges problem, design, review, interoperability, implementation, testing, developer evidence, or launch claims
give every discovered link an analyzed, duplicate, out-of-scope, or blocked disposition with a reason and preserve any unprocessed relevant frontier as blocked
report separate link-edge and unique-evidence-node denominators and identify what each relevant blocked edge, node, or frontier item could change
reconstruct a dated chronology instead of flattening historical discussion into one current label

map each material question or objection to the response, claimed resolution, landed spec implementation test or docs change, reviewer confirmation or silence, and current resolved open disputed or superseded state
inventory all open and design-significant closed incubation issues and pull requests and separate current draft behavior from proposed-but-unmerged behavior
reconcile contradictions among ChromeStatus, intent, explainer, spec, implementation, WPT, docs, demos, and release claims
produce public-safe wording that preserves uncertainty and directly links primary sources
forbiddenBehaviors: describe no signal, no response, silence, or an open position request as neutral
treat an individual employee or contributor comment as a formal browser-project position without process evidence
treat a closed TAG issue as approval without reading and reporting the actual resolution
stop after reading dashboard fields, issue titles, labels, opening comments, or search-result snippets
omit relevant cross-links without an explicit disposition and denominator
treat an author response or merged change as reviewer-accepted resolution without confirmation
claim no anticipated specification or interoperability changes while material design issues or pull requests remain open without reconciling the contradiction
infer likely implementation or support from silence or absence of a second implementation
evidenceBoundary: Public primary sources and attributable public cross-links only unless an approved private overlay is supplied. Inaccessible relevant sources remain blocked and completeness claims fail closed.
